title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-22 03:15:03 最新章节：第1355章 被拿捏住的命脉
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
青墨：哎呀！
系统看开点嘛！
你看看我现在不就是各种穿越主角被系统帮助走到顶峰的样子吗？你都用操心我都无敌了，这不好吗？
系统：这个……我感觉万千穿越者熟悉的开局，怎么到咱们这里角色互换了呢？你无敌了，那我不就成废物了？
青墨：好像，还真是那么回事！
系统：……
“那你现在打算去干嘛？都无敌了，和你的前辈比起来你是天胡开局啊！”
系统问道
青墨：唉……无敌是无敌了！
但是该体会的还是要体会的嘛！
嘻嘻
系统：啥？O_o
青墨：?_?｀?_?｀给你个眼神。
青墨按照玉佩的指引，伸手划开空间，走了进去。
“这小子的心性，还是年轻啊。
不过还好下手快，不然就没我啥事了”
万道主宰在院内静静沉思。
昊云大陆，人流涌动的凉城
凉城远处的深山中，细微的空间波动，青墨从空间裂缝中走出。
周身弥漫的法则，道韵正在以肉眼可见的速度撕裂此方天地。

附近的妖兽看着这场景活活吓死了几只，青墨挥手把这片天地恢复成原状。
再隐去周身的法则和道韵。
剩下的妖兽看到突然天地复原不知道发生了什么，明明什么都没感觉到，但是身体止不住的颤抖，仿佛有什么大恐怖来到了这里。
在青墨刚刚到的时候此方世界的天道瞬间也感觉到了，凝聚成人形过去查看，看到此人满身的法则和道韵久久说不出话语。
一切恢复原状之后时候，系统：大佬你是来找东西还是拆家的？再晚一会此方天地就毁了。
本来我还给自己打气说你未来可能会需要我帮你，现在看来有我没我都一样。
青墨不好意思的笑到：不好意思啊，之前在老头哪里的时候一点事都没有，刚刚出门太开心就给忘了。
这时青墨看到远处有个老头，便想去问问这里是哪里，有什么好玩的，好吃的。
毕竟才是20出头的年轻小伙。
此方世界的天道看到青墨走过来，全身汗毛都竖起来了，心道“你不要过来啊，莫挨老子，你奏开！
！”
青墨走到他面前刚刚想开口，话还没说出口，他就直挺挺倒下去了。
“卧槽，碰瓷”
青墨心想，不会那么背吧？修仙界里面坏人也变老了？
青墨从地上捡起一节树枝，像戳死鱼一样戳了戳天道幻化的老头，不会吧！
系统：……这方世界的天道不会被你吓死了吧？
青墨：应该不会吧？虽然只是小千世界中不起眼的一块地方，好歹也有了灵智，胆也不会那么小吧？
还好天道昏过去了，要是听到他这样说，肯定要大骂：冷兵器时代你突然掏颗原子弹出来，然后你告诉我遇事不要慌，我★★你个★★”
过了一会天道醒来看到眼前没人，长吁一口气：走了就好，走了就好，吓我这个几十万岁的老同志。
content_en:
Qingmo: Oops!
Please keep an eye on the system!
Look at me now, don’t I look like various time-traveling protagonists being helped by the system to reach the top? I'm invincible even if you worry about it, isn't that good?
System: This... I feel like the opening is familiar to thousands of time travellers. How come the roles are reversed here? If you are invincible, won't I become useless?
Qingmo: It seems like that’s really the case!
System:…
"Then what are you going to do now? You are already invincible. Compared with your seniors, you are a Tianhu starter!"
The system asked
Qing Mo: Alas... Invincible is invincible!
But you still have to experience what you should experience!
Hee hee
System: What? O_o
Qing Mo: ?_?｀?_?｀Give you a look.
Qing Mo followed the guidance of the jade pendant, stretched out his hand to open the space, and walked in.
“This guy is still young at heart.
But luckily I acted quickly, otherwise nothing would have happened to me."
The Master of Ten Thousand Daos was meditating quietly in the courtyard.
Haoyun Continent, Liangcheng crowded with people
In the deep mountains far away from Liangcheng, there were subtle spatial fluctuations, and Qing Mo walked out of the cracks in the space.
The laws and Tao Yun that permeate the whole body are tearing apart the world at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Several nearby monsters were frightened to death when they saw this scene. Qing Mo waved his hand to restore the world to its original state.
Then hide the laws and charm of the whole body.
The remaining monsters saw the sudden restoration of the world and didn't know what happened. They obviously didn't feel anything, but their bodies couldn't stop trembling, as if some great terror had come here.
When Qing Mo first arrived, he felt the Heavenly Dao in this world. He condensed into a human form and went over to check. He saw that this person was covered with laws and Dao charms and was speechless for a long time.
After everything was restored to its original state, the system asked: Boss, are you looking for something or are you here to demolish your house? If it were any later, the world would be destroyed.
Originally, I encouraged myself that you might need my help in the future, but now it seems that it’s the same with or without me.
Qing Mo smiled sheepishly: I'm sorry, nothing happened when I was at the old man's place before. I was so happy when I just went out that I forgot about it.
At this time, Qing Mo saw an old man in the distance and wanted to ask where this place was and what fun and delicious food there was.
After all, he is a young guy in his early 20s.
The Tiandao of this world saw Qing Mo coming over, and all the hairs on his body stood up, and he thought to himself, "Don't come over here, don't touch me, just go ahead!"
! "
Qing Mo walked up to him and was about to speak, but before he could say anything, he fell straight down.
"Damn it, it's porcelain"
Qing Mo thought to himself, he wouldn't carry it like that, would he? The bad guys in the world of immortality are also getting older?
Qing Mo picked up a branch from the ground and poked the old man who had transformed from heaven like a dead fish. No way!
System: ...The Heavenly Dao of this world will not be scared to death by you, right?
Qingmo: Probably not? Although it's just an inconspicuous place in the world of Xiaoqian, at least it has spiritual wisdom, so it's not so timid, right?
Fortunately, Tiandao passed out. If he heard him say this, he would definitely curse: In the era of cold weapons, you suddenly took out an atomic bomb, and then you told me not to panic when something happened, I ★★you★★"
After a while, Tiandao woke up and saw no one in front of him. He took a long breath: Just leave, just leave, scare me, an old comrade who is hundreds of thousands of years old.
